reviews.title: Best flexibility in custom mode
reviews.text: Who has time for a 30-second cooldown? This app lets you adjust cooldown time as low as 15 seconds—perfect amount of time to transition to the next exercise and best opportunity for efficient workout. Lots of different exercises to target three main muscles groups (upper/core/lower) and further customize as desired. Because it’s time-based rather than rep-based, you give every exercise your best effort for the time period and then move to the next. I have used this app for more than a thousand workouts. I havent been to the gym in 6 years and am in the best shape of my life.

reviews.title: Pretty good, but needs improvement
reviews.text:
EDIT:
This app progresses WAYYY too fast for a complete beginner. There also needs to be an option to turn on real-time, verbal instructions for each exercise so you don’t have to read each exercise before a workout to learn new exercises and to make sure you are learning, following, and continuing to implement proper form for each exercise as you progress.

Overall, I like the app. But there are no mobility or flexibility routines built in. And no warm-ups. This creates problems down the road, and it would be nice not to have to use a different app or set of videos for this before and after the workouts on this app.

There are also no assessments or graphs of your progress. Other paid apps have these useful tools.

Some of the GIFs are wrong. The “glute bridge” shows the shoulders and arms in red as if they are being engaged. But the exercise is supposed to focus on the glutes. This is very misleading.
